Photo by Joe DelNero, NLR 101349 16 | Advanced Computing Annual Report 2025 Advanced Computing Annual Report 2025 | 17 Charting Energy Savings Across the U.S. Building Stock NLR’s BuildStock platform combines its commercial (ComStock™) and residential (ResStock™) building models to generate datasets of end-use savings profiles. The profiles show the difference in hourly energy consumption between baseline buildings and buildings with some "what-if" measure scenario applied that improves energy efficiency or demand flexibility. Each time series profile is disaggregated by end use and fuel type. BuildStock leverages Kestrel to run millions of building energy simulations that estimate energy usage across the building stock and for the intensive data processing required to produce the individual profiles and complete dataset. With funding from DOE’s CMEI, in FY 2025, BuildStock added three new ComStock datasets, 31 measure scenarios, and 13 reports. NLR conducted a user engagement survey to understand BuildStock's reach: more than 2,200 companies and 7,500 individuals spanning 143 utilities, 76 financial INTEGRATED ENERGY institutions, 165 startups, and more than 600 consulting firms have applied BuildStock data.
